name: 怖须菇
evolution: 哭哭菇 → 怖须菇 Lv.24 → 怖哭菇 Lv.38
description: 会将身体埋入土壤中，依靠独特的腺体将吸收的水分转化为带有毒性的黏液，干燥与炎热时，散发的气味微微发酸，闻到会想起悲伤的事情。
descriptionEn: It buries its body in soil, using its unique glands to convert absorbed water into toxic mucus. When dry and hot, the emitted smell is slightly sour, reminding those who smell it of sad things.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, in response to attacks.

skills.name: 偷师
skills.description: 造成物伤，自己回复1能量。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, restores 1 energy to self.

skills.name: 星云漩涡
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy creature.

skills.name: 星链
skills.description: 2连击，每次连击使敌方获得1层星陨印记。
skills.descriptionEn: 2 hits; each hit gives the enemy 1 Starfall Mark.

skills.name: 嗜痛
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：期间自己每受到1次攻击伤害，获得双攻+40%。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%, in response to attacks: during this, each time it takes attack damage, gains both attacks +40%.

skills.name: 当头棒喝
skills.description: 造成物伤，若敌方本回合更换精灵，本次技能威力+100。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; if the enemy switched creatures this turn, this skill's power +100.

skills.name: 触底强击
skills.description: 造成魔伤，使用后若能量耗尽，本次技能威力+120。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; after use, if energy is depleted, this skill's power +120.

skills.name: 血气
skills.description: 减伤60%，应对攻击：本回合受到致命伤害时，保留1生命值。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 60%; in response to attacks: when taking lethal damage this turn, retain 1 HP.

skills.name: 多维击打
skills.description: 造成魔伤，1连击，敌方每有1层星陨印记，本次技能连击数+1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, 1 hit; for each Starfall Mark the enemy has, this skill's hit count +1.

skills.name: 四维降解
skills.description: 造成魔伤，敌方每有1层印记，本技能能耗-1。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; for each Mark the enemy has, this skill's energy cost -1.

skills.name: 冥想
skills.description: 减伤80%，应对攻击：敌方获得2层星陨印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 80%; in response to attacks: enemy gains 2 Starfall Marks.

skills.name: 错乱
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：敌方获得3层星陨印记。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; in response to status: enemy gains 3 Starfall Marks.

skills.name: 突袭
skills.description: 造成魔伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为3倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage; in response to status: this skill's power becomes 3x.
